tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Isla wants to talk about clean-up day. which area to help. what gloves to bring. when to start.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Isla.

promptBlocks.subject: Community day
paragraphs: I am writing about clean-up day. which area to help? what gloves to bring?
when to start? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Isla and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: clean-up day
ketImageBrief.panel1: Isla starts clean-up day with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Isla solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
